title: Apply to review an overdue fine in court
summary: Find out how to apply to have an overdue fine heard in court.
intro:
If you want to have an overdue fine heard in court, you will need to:

Note: Your application will be delayed if your hindrance reason is not provided.
who_can_apply: The person named on the fine notice.
The vehicle owner (if there is no name on the notice).
The authorised representative of the person named on the notice.
what_you_need: Your email address, phone number, and date of birth.
Your residential address (PO boxes are not accepted) to post your Court Attendance Notice (CAN).
Copies of supporting evidence (such as medical or travel documents).
PDF form – Request to Have a Fine Decided in Court – Individual.
PDF form – Request to Have a Fine Decided in Court – Organisation (if applying as a company).

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to complete and submit your application.
Send your supporting documents via post to:Revenue NSWPO Box 786Strawberry Hills NSW 2012
Put a request in writing and send it by post.

more_info.text: Any demerit points from the fine will remain until your court election is approved.
Your application may take up to 6 weeks to assess from the date you submit it. Your fine will be placed on hold while your application is being assessed.
Once you've received your CAN, it's too late to withdraw from attending court. If you've changed your mind, contact the court listed in your CAN and ask them about your options.
In preparation for your court date, you may wish to review the court process, or get free legal information and referral services from Legal Aid NSW.

faqs.q: Who can apply to review an overdue fine in court?
faqs.a: The person named on the fine notice, the vehicle owner (if no name is on the notice), or the authorised representative of the person named on the notice.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply?
faqs.a: You need the fine notice number, your driver licence number, your email address, phone number, date of birth, residential address (PO boxes are not accepted), your hindrance reason, supporting evidence (like medical or travel documents), and the appropriate PDF form.

faqs.q: How do I submit my application?
faqs.a: You can check eligibility, gather documents, select 'Go to myPenalty', follow the prompts to submit online, send supporting documents via post, complete the required PDF form, and put a request in writing and send it by post.
